services.name: Dive trip
services.desc: We are the dropzone in the poconos where you can enjoy the most amazing views of the mountains. Our drop zone is build into the most high safety standards to make sure everyone have a perfect experience improving their selves. We accept fun jumpers for all over the world with USPA currency rules. If you need to do a recurrency jumps or finish your license process our coaches are going to be more than happy to help you, make sure to bring your logbook and your rig with a reserve pack in date. “Thinking about getting your license? explain.meaning: You jump strapped to an instructor who handles the parachute.

blurb: Guests experience skydiving over the Pocono Mountains with expert instructors. The facility prioritizes safety with experienced instructors, top-of-the-line equipment, and quality airplanes and facilities. They offer tandem skydiving for first-timers, a skydiving school to learn solo jumping and earn a license, and opportunities for experienced jumpers.

quotes.author: Edgar Class
quotes.text: What an amazing experience compared to other locations, there are bilingual for those who speak Spanish, they are all warm hearted people, jokesters, and you can tell they love what they do. Family and friends who didn’t even jump enjoyed their time there. They even helped me propose to my now fiancé and gave me great footage to cherish the memory for a life time. Thank you again crew!

quotes.author: Rose Voigtsberger
quotes.text: I never in my life did I think I would jump out of a plane. Daniel made me feel safe and secure, and Hayley hyped me up to go. Not only was this the most incredible experience of my life but it was the most fun I’ve had doing something way out of my comfort zone. Highly recommend and would definitely do it again!

quotes.author: Christopher Ziemann
quotes.text: A Fantastic group of people that made my Tandem Jump experience amazing! The extra expense to have a third party videographer made my "memories" so much better. My instructor and the videographer, super personalities, made me feel warm and welcome and safe.
